FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Combat Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates manual battles to actually take advantage of the combat efficiency stat.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds two hediffs (a buff and a debuff) that impact a pawn's shooting accuracy, melee hit chance, melee dodge change, aiming dely factor, and move speed based on their combat efficiency

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Rewards Fix
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes events that grant animal rewards.

patchNoteLines.li: Fixes the animal event reward to properly include all animals in its filter

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Pawn generation fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes Empire-generated pawns to not generate pawn relations.

patchNoteLines.li: Disables pawn relation generation for Empire-generated pawns
